author: Ronald Clark
title: Screaming Eagles look dominant in exhibition - NewsBreak
text:
By Ronald Clark No media credit provided. ,
49 minutes ago
EVANSVILLE, Ind. (WEHT) — The University of Southern Indiana women’s soccer team hosted Bellarmine in Strassweg Field for their first exhibition of the season Wednesday night.
With the match being an exhibition, there was no official final score, but Southern Indiana officials confirmed the Screaming Eagles won the match.
USI will be back in action Saturday, August 8th, at Kennesaw State for their final exhibition of the year at noon.
